readmeSignals.title: Workspace mode — review all staged, unstaged, and untracked changes
readmeSignals.summary: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews

readmeSignals.title: TensorFold
readmeSignals.summary: TensorFold serves language models from a Zig binary on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs. The engine reads checkpoints, tokenizes requests and runs Metal or CUDA kernels directly. Serving needs no Python or MLX installation. Building with a coding agent? Have it load the docs/recipes/SKILL.md before it writes any code. Please use https://github.com/ashhart/ATC before editing TensorFold so contributors and agents can avoid duplicate work and conflicting changes. Check the https://tensorfold.dev/atc before choosing an issue and follow CONTRIBUTING.md and the docs/atc/SKILL.md.
